zh: 先不管奇偶，把所有正数都选上得到的和最大；如果这个和已经是偶数，它就是答案。
若正数之和是奇数，就必须改变某个奇数的选取状态才能变成偶数：要么去掉一个已选的正奇数，要么加入一个负奇数。增删偶数不改变奇偶性，只会让结果变差。
求出所有正数之和 S；S 为偶数时直接输出。否则找出最小的正奇数 p 和最接近 0 的负奇数 q，候选值为 S−p 与 S+q（只考虑存在的那个），再与一个都不选的 0 比较取最大值输出。判断奇偶时注意负数取余的符号。
en: Ignoring parity, taking every positive number gives the largest sum; if that sum is already even, it is the answer.

If the sum of the positives is odd, some odd number's choice must flip to fix the parity: either drop a chosen positive odd number or add a negative odd number. Adding or dropping even numbers does not change parity and only makes the result worse.

Compute S, the sum of all positive numbers; output it if it is even. Otherwise find the smallest positive odd p and the negative odd q closest to 0; the candidates are S - p and S + q (only those that exist), compared with 0 for choosing nothing, and the maximum is the answer. Mind the sign of the remainder for negative numbers when testing oddness.

explanationEn:
## Approach

First take all positive numbers to get the maximum sum; if it is odd, compare two fixes: removing the smallest positive odd number, or adding the negative odd number closest to 0.

## Proof of correctness

The sum of all positive numbers is the maximum when no parity condition is imposed. If it is odd, any feasible solution must at least remove a positive odd number or add a negative odd number; choosing whichever of these two adjustments loses the least gives the maximum even sum.

## Complexity

O(n), space O(n).
